items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 34:1
items.html: Answer: there are here three particular orders, which must not be compared one to another. The first order is the thirteen Sefirot of the surrounding ones of the beard, in which Malchut is above all of them and Bina is below, and this is from the aspect of the Hochma of the Mocha Stima'ah; and from the aspect of the Keter of the Mocha Stima'ah, Yesod is above and Hesed is below. And this is immediately with their emergence in the aspect of the surplus of the Mocha from the Rosh of AA, before they received any light; or what remained of the Sefirot that were not corrected in the thirteen inner [corrections], which also remain without light and stand in the aspect of surrounding ones. For this reason, the coarser each one is, the lower it is, and the Malchut, being the finest of them all, is found above them all, etc., as above in answer 83, see there. And after this began the couplings, which are the corrections, to be corrected little by little, in the order of the degree: in pregnancy, and smallness, and the VAK of Gadlut, and the GAR of Gadlut, in the order explained above in answer 151, see there, until all the thirteen corrections of the beard were completed in their perfection. And once they were completed in their perfection, the order of the thirteen inner Sefirot was made, in which the Bina of the Hochma of the Mocha Stima'ah now stands above all of them, being the tallest stature of them all, and she stands in the first correction by the name El. And after her, Hesed in the second correction, etc., and the Malchut of the Hochma of the Mocha Stima'ah in the eighth correction by the name "and keeping mercy," where the Hesed of the Keter of the Mocha Stima'ah is also included, and the Gevura of the Keter in the ninth correction, etc., and the Yesod of the Keter below all of them, namely in their order, that every stature that is higher is above more.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 34:2
items.html: And these two orders operate in all the Partzufim: at first, when the vessels are without lights, namely before they received any coupling on the coarseness in their screen, the coarseness is found to be a lack in them, and therefore the coarser each one is, the more lacking it is and the lower it is. But at the time when the lights are already clothed in them, which is through the coupling of the upper light on the coarseness in their screen, then the coarser each one is, the taller its stature and the higher it is, as above in answer 83. And these are the two orders mentioned above, of the surrounding ones and of the inner ones. However, it is known that the Partzuf does not grow all at once in all its degrees, but little by little, in the order of the degree: at first comes the Nefesh in the vessel of Keter, and when the Ruach comes, the Nefesh descends to the vessel of Hochma, and the Ruach clothes in the vessel of Keter. And when the Neshama comes, the Nefesh descends to the vessel of Bina, the Ruach clothes in the vessel of Hochma, and the Neshama clothes in the vessel of Keter, etc., in this manner, as is known. And this is the third order mentioned above, of the emergence of the thirteen corrections of the beard. For here too, at first the Nefesh was revealed in the first correction at the time of its coming into the second correction, in the first pregnancy, namely the VAK of Nefesh; and when the third correction was revealed, when the GAR of Nefesh came out, the GAR of Nefesh clothed in the first correction, and the VAK of Nefesh descended to the second correction. And afterward, in the fourth correction, when the VAK of Ruach was revealed, the VAK of Nefesh descended to the third correction, the GAR of Nefesh to the second correction, and the VAK of Ruach clothed in the first correction. And afterward, in the fifth correction, when the GAR of Ruach was revealed, the VAK of Nefesh descended to the fourth correction, the GAR of Nefesh to the third correction, the VAK of Ruach to the second correction, and the GAR of Ruach rose and clothed in the first correction. And after this, at the time when the sixth correction was revealed, which is the VAK of Gadlut, the VAK of Nefesh descended to the fifth correction, the GAR of Nefesh descended to the fourth correction, the VAK of Ruach to the fifth correction, and the GAR of Ruach descended from the first correction to the second correction, and the VAK of Gadlut clothed in the first correction. And afterward, in the seventh correction, when the GAR of Gadlut came out, the VAK of Nefesh descended to the sixth correction, the GAR of Nefesh to the fifth correction, the VAK of Ruach to the fourth correction, the GAR of Ruach to the third correction, the VAK of Gadlut to the second correction, and the GAR of Gadlut in the first correction. And after this came out the aspect of the totality in the eighth correction, which is the aspect of the height of the Mochin, and then the VAK of Nefesh descended to the seventh correction, the GAR of Nefesh to the sixth correction, the VAK of Ruach to the fifth correction, the GAR of Ruach to the fourth correction, the VAK of Gadlut to the third correction, the GAR of Gadlut to the second correction, and the totality of the beard, which is the height of the Mochin, clothed in the first correction. And the entry of all the lights into their vessels was now completed properly, in the order of the thirteen inner [Sefirot], with Bina above in the first correction and Malchut below in the eighth correction.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 34:3
items.html: Because the aspect of the totality that clothed in the first correction is discerned as the aspect of Bina. And the aspect of the GAR of Gadlut, which is Hochma that clothed in the second correction, is discerned as the Sefira of Hesed; and the VAK of Gadlut, which clothed in the third correction, is discerned as the aspect of Gevura; and the GAR of Ruach, which clothed in the fourth correction, is discerned as Tifferet; and the VAK of Ruach, which clothed in the fifth correction, is discerned as Netzach; and the GAR of Nefesh, which clothed in the sixth correction, is discerned as Hod; and the VAK of Nefesh, which clothed in the seventh correction, is discerned as the aspect of Yesod; and the eighth correction is discerned as Malchut, which receives from all of them.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 34:4
items.html: And do not wonder how the GAR of Hochma is discerned as the Sefira of Hesed, and the VAK of Hochma as the aspect of Gevura, and the GAR of Ruach as the aspect of Tifferet, etc., for this has already been explained well above in the words of the Rav, in "reaching and not reaching" (Mati veLo Mati), and in the Ohr Pnimi there, page 329, Sub Header "now you will understand"; see there, in all the order of the emanation of the VAK. And you will see there that Hesed is the GAR of the illumination of Hochma, and Gevura is the VAK of the illumination of Hochma, and Tifferet is the GAR of Ruach; see there. And this is not the place to elaborate further. And in this manner are also explained the five Sefirot of Keter in the three orders mentioned above. And understand well.
